content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks nigeria

Conventional platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle promise simplicity but operate as walled gardens. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery—until they don’t. For Nigerian creators, these platforms are inaccessible or unreliable. In contrast, sovereign commerce stacks like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide self-owned infrastructure. You host on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, process payments via NOWPayments (300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee), and deliver files from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The stack automates order fulfillment without relying on third-party APIs. The tradeoff is clear: platforms offer convenience until they fail you; sovereign stacks offer permanence at the cost of initial setup.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on compliance risk, not technical limitations. Gumroad and Paddle follow suit, blocking accounts tied to restricted regions. Even if you bypass restrictions, these platforms retain the power to suspend your account or withhold funds. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. By deploying your own infrastructure, you eliminate platform dependency. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores orders, and crypto payments bypass traditional banking. The system operates regardless of your location—built for creators in Zimbabwe, Venezuela, or Nigeria who need infrastructure that doesn’t discriminate.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms charge 5–10% per transaction, plus hidden fees for currency conversion or chargebacks. Crypto payments via NOWPayments cost 0.5%, with no KYC or buyer account required. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. While platforms promise instant payouts, they often delay or freeze funds for restricted accounts. Sovereign stacks deliver payments directly to your wallet, with webhooks firing the moment transactions confirm on-chain. The real cost comparison: platforms charge more and control your revenue flow; sovereign stacks charge less and give you full control.
Platforms exclude you based on policy, not technology.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms, you rent functionality. With sovereign stacks, you own the code, data, and deployment. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration, ensuring your delivery emails don’t land in spam. File delivery is automated via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, with no third-party services required. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access to your stack—you retain full control. This architecture is designed for creators who want to build once and own forever, not rent month-to-month.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re a Nigerian creator selling ebooks, courses, or templates, conventional platforms are a dead end. Sovereign commerce stacks are the only permanent solution. Choose the Edge Commerce Stack if you need a fully deployed system in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. Choose the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) if you prefer to deploy manually using the provided docs and source code. The decision comes down to time vs. control: the stack saves you time; the blueprint gives you flexibility. Either way, you own the outcome.

Sovereign commerce stacks win for Nigerian creators because they eliminate platform dependency. Unlike Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, these stacks use open infrastructure (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, NOWPayments) that operates regardless of your location. Crypto payments bypass banking restrictions, and self-hosted files ensure instant delivery. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this architecture for you, providing a fully operational store without recurring fees or platform risk.
Sovereign stacks give you ownership, not rental agreements.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack for deployment within 48 hours or Sovereign Blueprint for manual setup. 2. Provide product details (title, description, price) for loading into your store. 3. Select your preferred cryptocurrencies and configure NOWPayments webhook integration. 4. Deploy your stack to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. 5. Test end-to-end functionality, including payment processing and file delivery. 6. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email delivery reliability. 7. Launch your store and retain full ownership of your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you, requiring no technical skills. The Sovereign Blueprint includes full documentation for manual deployment.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates as a payment processor, not a platform. If it fails, you can replace it with another crypto gateway without affecting your stack.
Do buyers need a crypto wallet to purchase?
Yes, but they don’t need an account with NOWPayments. They send payment directly from their wallet, and the webhook automates delivery.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your wallet. The stack doesn’t include automated refunds, as this requires platform-level control.
Can I scale this beyond ebooks?
Yes. The stack supports any digital product. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates for courses, software, and more.
Crypto payments cost less and confirm faster than traditional methods.
